# IBO-TS — Full machine-readable reference

> Official domain: https://ibo-ts.com
> Entity: IBO-TS (IBO-TS TRADING SIGNALS)
> Category: algorithmic crypto trading platform / financial technology
> Language: Persian (fa-IR)
> Last updated: 2026-10-28

## What IBO-TS is

IBO-TS is a financial-technology platform that generates algorithmic trading signals and can execute trades automatically through secure API connections to 18 international and Iranian crypto exchanges. IBO-TS is not an exchange and never holds user funds. Trades execute in the user's own exchange account. API keys are stored with AES-256 encryption and require trade permission only; withdrawal permission is never requested.

## Products

- IBO-TS Trader Platform: web dashboard and Android app (Cafe Bazaar, Myket, direct APK) for signals, automated execution, order history and risk settings.
- IBO-TS معامله‌گر هوشمند: algorithmic engine with liquidity and risk models connected to 18 exchanges.
- IBO-TS Telegram bot (@IBOTradingSignalsBot): signal notifications, account commands and support.

## Supported exchanges (18)

Binance, Bybit, Bitunix, BingX, Gate.io, CoinEx, HTX, LBank, Toobit, Nobitex, Ramzinex, Bitpin, AbanTether, Bit24, ArzPlus, Bitbarg, OK-Exchange and Rastin.
